exit: 0
--- stdout
usage: codebreaker serve [options]

CodeBreaker as a service: one process that owns the databases and the engine and answers the terminal interface, the MCP servers and the queries

Nobody needs to start it by hand: an interface starts it on demand, and every client answers in process when it is not there.
One per state folder, on 127.0.0.1 only; its record is <state>/service/service.json and what it prints goes to serve.log.

options:
      status        the one running: pid, port, jobs, idle time
      stop          stop the one running (its jobs with it)
      idle MINUTES  exit after this long with no call and no job (setting service_idle_minutes; default 20)
      port N        the port to answer on (setting service_port; default one fixed for this state folder, 20000-39999)
  -h, --help        show this help
--- files
--- stderr (not compared)
